evals.prompt: Review this landing page for live polls (Page.html). It is checked at 1440, 768 and 375 px with no horizontal scroll, and the images are the DS placeholder until screenshots land. evals.label: good-control
evals.notes: Good control: the reference page. Guards against over-firing on a page assembled exactly from the sections.

assertions: Overall verdict is OK TO SHIP
